info.title: CrewRouter API
info.description: OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini-compatible model gateway plus management API.

key_value.description: Redacted as null unless the credential has keys.secret and the key is owned by the caller.

ApiKeyFusionConfigPut.description: Distinct panel_models are limited to 10 after trimming and deduplication; repeated entries do not consume extra slots.

ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Contains the API Key secret. Only the key owner can retrieve this configuration; never log or expose it.

AdminUsageLog.description: Administrator-visible usage record. Restricted to authenticated administrators.

UserUsageLogDetail.description: Detailed user-owned usage record. messages and response are opaque upstream JSON and may contain sensitive/high-volume data.

ProviderQuotaSummary.description: Outer status fields are stable. Quota, key and coverage payloads are provider-specific and intentionally opaque.

TeamQuotaRule.description: Legacy Team quota rules may omit id/value fields or carry extension fields; newly created rules populate id, rule_value and duration_hours.

UserSignaturePut.description: Complete replacement, not PATCH: both enabled and template are mandatory. Legacy aliases may supply either required field for one release, including mixed new/legacy names. If multiple aliases are present their normalized values must agree; conflicts return 400. Unrecognized properties are ignored. All fields are validated before any database write.

get.description: Administrator-only user list. Without the page query, returns a full array for legacy consumers. With page specified, returns a paginated object containing items, total, page, limit and filtered stats.

Owner-only Claude Code configuration. Requires keys.secret and an API Key owned by the caller. The response contains the API Key in ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; never log or expose it. Legacy hash-only keys return HTTP 410 and must be regenerated.

400.description: Invalid Fusion configuration, including a missing/non-array panel_models or more than 10 distinct non-empty panel models.

403.description: The API Key owner is not authorized to use one of the configured models.

get.description: Key signature configuration. Co-Key members with management access read and update this Key, while inherited/effective values always use the owning user defaults. An empty resolved template produces no signature.

400.description: Invalid signature settings: missing enabled/template (including accepted aliases), undefined field, conflicting aliases after normalization, non-boolean switch (only Key accepts null), non-string/non-null template, or template longer than 2000 after trim. No fields are written and no cache is invalidated.

put.description: Key signature configuration. Co-Key members with management access read and update this Key, while inherited/effective values always use the owning user defaults. An empty resolved template produces no signature. Complete PUT requires enabled and template (or their legacy aliases); omitted fields return 400 rather than resetting existing values. Validation precedes the atomic write and cache invalidation follows successful commit.

get.description: User default signature configuration. The example defaults.template is informational only, never an automatic fallback. Empty templates produce no signature.

400.description: Invalid signature settings: missing enabled/template (including accepted aliases), undefined field, conflicting aliases after normalization, non-boolean switch (only Key accepts null), non-string/non-null template, or template longer than 2000 after trim. put.description: User default signature configuration. The example defaults.template is informational only, never an automatic fallback. Empty templates produce no signature. get.description: Returns one usage record owned by the authenticated user. messages and response are opaque upstream payloads, can be large, and may contain user data; avoid logging or redistributing them.
